task: Reconcile trusted fast-forward main evolution across the complete parent Truth/Lifecycle/persistence closure route without weakening CLOSED child output integrity.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Release Unit Execution #278 reached parent TRUTH_GATE only after U01/U02/U03 were CLOSED, then failed with RELEASE_PARENT_FINAL_MAIN_DRIFT because parent closure defines finalImplementationMain as the last child merge SHA 4cab9376... and requires origin/main to remain byte-exact equal. Required fail-closed Control Plane hardening then advanced main to 68877e11... without changing any CLOSED child intended output. The same stale-base assumption exists again after closure PR creation as RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_MAIN_DRIFT. Fixing only the first equality check would therefore move the same model defect downstream. Parent closure needs one bounded main-reconciliation contract covering both pre-proof and persistence phases.
observableOutcomes: A parent whose units are all CLOSED may adopt a newer current main only when the last child merge is an ancestor of current main and a canonical parent-main-advance proof binds the exact from/to SHAs and current unit close receipts.
The parent-main-advance proof protects the aggregate CLOSED child material scope: any changed intended file or rename previousFile causes fail-closed rejection before parent proof.

Trusted post-child Control Plane/proof-surface changes outside CLOSED child material output may advance the effective final main only after the full parent Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Replay/Risk/Customer/Market/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof passes on that exact current main.
recordReleaseParentClosure validates and persists the parent-main-advance proof when finalMain differs from the last child merge SHA; forged, stale or scope-overlapping proofs fail closed.
The closure PR is based on the accepted effective final main and records that base in closurePersistence.

If main advances while the closure PR is pending, the executor does not merge stale closure state and does not permanently dead-end. It re-proves the new fast-forward main, reruns full parent proof, refreshes the dedicated executor-owned closure branch using exact lease protection, reuses the same open PR and returns PENDING for exact PR-head CI.
If persistence main advance is non-fast-forward or changes any CLOSED child material output, the existing parent closure remains BLOCK and no stale PR is merged.

An end-to-end regression drives CLOSED children -> initial trusted main advance -> parent proof -> closure PR -> second trusted main advance -> closure reprojection -> exact CI -> merge/final receipt.
unresolvedRisks: Allowing arbitrary descendant main would let post-close changes overwrite child material while parent truth claims success.
Protecting only the last unit would miss corruption of earlier CLOSED unit outputs.
Treating read-only/dependency/proof-surface changes as immutable child output would recreate the current self-blocking hardening loop.
Refreshing the closure branch without force-with-lease could overwrite concurrent executor state.
Creating a second closure PR instead of reusing the executor-owned PR would break resumability and duplicate persistence work.
Merging a closure PR whose base advanced after its exact proof would persist stale parent lifecycle state.
A proof not bound to unit close receipt digests could be replayed against a different parent state.
A rename can hide deletion of a protected path unless diff classification disables rename collapsing or explicitly protects previousFile.

in: Define and validate a parent-main-advance proof contract bound to fromSha, toSha, FAST_FORWARD relationship, changed files, aggregate protected child material files and unit close receipt digests.
Protect every CLOSED unit intended file plus rename previousFile from post-close main advance.
Use current trusted main as effective parent finalMain only after the parent-main-advance proof passes.
Run the existing full parent proof unchanged on the effective current main.
Persist accepted main-advance proof in the parent close receipt for auditability.
Reconcile a second main advance while closurePersistence is PR_OPEN by re-proving and reprojecting closure instead of merging stale closure state.
Refresh only the dedicated release-execution/closure branch with force-with-lease against the observed remote head and reuse its open PR.
Add full-route regression coverage for both main-advance points and fail-closed variants.
out: No weakening of child exact-head verification, unit close receipts, Completion Truth, Lifecycle Closure, CAS state persistence or PR-head CI.
No manual edit of canonical release-state branch.
No storefront, Builder, template, Supabase or deployment change.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This capability determines which repository state the parent is allowed to certify after all children close and whether a pending closure can survive later trusted main evolution. A false positive could certify modified child output; a false negative would permanently dead-end valid hardening.

acceptanceCriteria: No main advance is accepted without a verified git ancestor relationship from the prior accepted parent base to current main.
Changed-file enumeration uses rename-safe semantics so protected old paths cannot disappear through rename collapsing.
Protected child material scope is derived from every CLOSED unit intendedFiles plus operation.previousFile values.
Any protected-file overlap blocks before parent proof, regardless of green CI.
The proof is bound to the exact ordered unit close receipt digests in canonical state.
When current main equals the last child merged main, parent closure retains the existing no-advance behavior.
When current main is a safe proven fast-forward, parent Truth/Lifecycle run against current main and the close receipt finalMainSha equals that current main.
When main advances during PR_OPEN persistence, stale closure is not merged; closure is re-proved/reprojected on the new safe current main and the same executor-owned PR is refreshed.
Closure branch refresh uses force-with-lease bound to the observed remote head; lease mismatch blocks.
A reprojected closure requires fresh exact PR-head SUCCESS before merge.
Non-fast-forward, protected overlap, forged proof, receipt-digest mismatch, PR identity drift, lease drift and failing parent proof all remain fail-closed.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle Closure pass before merge of this hardening change.
Immutable rehearsal replay proceeds from #278 beyond RELEASE_PARENT_FINAL_MAIN_DRIFT and completes parent closure or exposes a genuinely different remaining blocker.
invariants: CLOSED child material output is immutable during parent closure.
Parent main reconciliation may evolve proof/runtime surfaces but may not rewrite CLOSED child material scope.
The parent close receipt identifies the exact main actually proven by Truth/Lifecycle.
Every accepted main advance is cryptographically/state-bound to the current CLOSED-unit receipts.
A pending closure PR is never merged after its proven base becomes stale.
Closure branch updates are executor-owned and compare-and-swap protected.
Canonical release state remains writable only through the existing executor persistence path.

failureModes: Current main is not a descendant of the last accepted child/final parent base.
Current main changes a CLOSED child intended file.
Current main renames a CLOSED child file and rename collapsing hides the original path.
Parent main proof uses stale unit close receipt digests.
Parent full proof fails on accepted current main.
Closure PR branch has moved independently from recorded persistence head.
Main advances while closure PR CI is running.
Closure branch refresh loses a race and force-with-lease rejects.
Existing closure PR is closed/unmerged when refresh is required.
Reprojected closure PR has not yet obtained exact-head green CI.
edgeCases: no main advance after last child close
safe fast-forward with only active-plan/proof/executor changes
safe fast-forward with unrelated non-child application change that still passes full parent proof
protected create fixture modified after child close
protected modify target edited after child close
two safe main advances: one before parent proof and one during closure PR
main advance occurs after closure PR exact CI but before merge
closure branch already exists from a prior interrupted reprojection
closure PR exists and tracks refreshed branch head

alternatives.summary: Prove fast-forward main evolution, protect all CLOSED child material, rerun full parent proof on current main and reproject pending closure on later safe main advance.
alternatives.reason: Preserves child material integrity and allows required Control Plane hardening without stale exact-SHA deadlock.

alternatives.summary: Treat any current main as final and rely only on green parent tests.
alternatives.reason: Could certify rewritten child material and destroys transaction identity.

alternatives.summary: Accept every descendant main regardless of changed files.
alternatives.reason: Fast-forward ancestry alone does not protect CLOSED child outputs.

alternatives.summary: Use current main before parent proof but keep exact persistence.baseSha requirement after closure PR creation.
alternatives.reason: Would merely move the same stale-main model defect to RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_MAIN_DRIFT.

alternatives.summary: Allow GitHub to merge the old closure PR onto a newer main if mergeable.
alternatives.reason: Closure Truth/Lifecycle would describe the old base, not the state being merged.

specialistReviews.finding: The parent currently conflates last child merge SHA with final certifiable main and therefore cannot tolerate its own hardening evolution.
specialistReviews.resolution: Introduce an explicit parent main reconciliation proof and define effective final main as the latest safe proven fast-forward state.

specialistReviews.finding: A generic descendant-main exception would allow post-close child tampering.
specialistReviews.resolution: Protect aggregate CLOSED child material and bind proof to exact close receipt digests before running parent proof.

specialistReviews.finding: Earlier units must remain protected, not only U03.
specialistReviews.resolution: Derive protected scope from every CLOSED unit intendedFiles plus rename previousFile and reject any overlap.

specialistReviews.finding: There are two stale-main checks in the remaining parent route, so a one-check patch is incomplete.
specialistReviews.resolution: Cover both pre-proof final-main selection and PR_OPEN persistence reconciliation in one capability and one end-to-end test.

specialistReviews.finding: The defect is reproducible on immutable source SHA 65e52ffd with source CI attempt 14 SUCCESS and Release Unit Execution #278.
specialistReviews.resolution: Failure Intake #1129 records the exact state and regression matrix; replay must use the same immutable source.

challenge.scenario: Current main is a safe descendant and changes only release executor diagnostics.
challenge.finding: Exact equality permanently dead-ends valid hardening.
challenge.resolution: Accept only through parent-main-advance proof then rerun full parent proof on current main.

challenge.scenario: Current main is a descendant but changes fixture-07 from U01.
challenge.finding: An all-descendant rule would certify corrupted earlier child output.
challenge.resolution: Aggregate protected material from every CLOSED unit; any overlap blocks.

challenge.scenario: A protected child file is renamed.
challenge.finding: Default rename detection can hide the original protected path in name-only output.
challenge.resolution: Use rename-safe diff semantics/disable rename collapsing and protect previousFile.

challenge.scenario: A proof generated for the same from/to SHAs is replayed after unit close receipts change.
challenge.finding: SHA binding alone is not enough to bind parent state identity.
challenge.resolution: Include and validate ordered unit close receipt digests.

challenge.scenario: Safe main advance passes structural proof but full parent Quality/Truth fails.
challenge.finding: Structural safety is not Completion Truth.
challenge.resolution: Main proof only admits the candidate; existing full parent proof remains mandatory on the candidate SHA.

challenge.scenario: Main advances while closure PR exact-head CI is running.
challenge.finding: Merging the old closure would certify a stale base.
challenge.resolution: Detect base drift before CI/merge, re-prove current main and refresh closure PR, then require new exact-head CI.

challenge.scenario: Closure branch already exists when reprojection creates a new closure commit from newer main.
challenge.finding: Normal push is non-fast-forward and either fails or tempts unsafe force push.
challenge.resolution: Read the exact remote closure head and update only with force-with-lease against that SHA.

challenge.scenario: Another actor updates closure branch between observation and refresh.
challenge.finding: Unconditional force would destroy concurrent state.
challenge.resolution: Lease mismatch fails closed; no retry by blind force.

challenge.scenario: Existing closure PR is open and branch refreshes.
challenge.finding: Creating a second PR duplicates persistence.
challenge.resolution: Reuse the existing open PR for the dedicated closure branch and verify refreshed head/base identity.

challenge.scenario: Existing closure PR was closed without merge.
challenge.finding: Silently reusing it would hide operator intervention.
challenge.resolution: Block and require explicit intake/recovery rather than creating duplicates automatically.

challenge.finding: The same invariant remains at RELEASE_PARENT_CLOSURE_MAIN_DRIFT.
challenge.resolution: End-to-end regression must exercise a second main advance during PR_OPEN and still reach final close.

challenge.scenario: A newer unrelated main commit does not touch child material but breaks project tests.
challenge.finding: Scope proof alone would accept an unhealthy final main.
challenge.resolution: Existing full parent gate chain reruns and blocks before persistence.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require canonical Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Add a pure release-parent-main-advance proof validator and receipt binding in shoperation-release-unit-runtime.mjs.

Add Git-backed proof generation in release-unit-parent-close.mjs using merge-base ancestry, rename-safe changed-file enumeration, aggregate CLOSED-child protected material and unit close receipt digests.
Run parent proof on the accepted effective current main and record its main-advance proof in the close receipt.
Make closure branch persistence resumable: observe current remote closure head, refresh only with force-with-lease, reuse the same open PR and validate head/base identity.
Move persistence main-drift detection before stale PR-head CI acceptance; on safe advance rerun parent proof and reproject closure, returning PENDING for a fresh exact-head CI.
Pass immutable sourceCommit through finishParentClosurePersistence so persistence reprojection can rerun the same parent plan authority.
Add pure fail-closed tests for non-fast-forward, protected overlap, renamed protected path, forged from/to, unit receipt digest mismatch and missing proof.
Add end-to-end helper test for CLOSED units -> safe advance A -> closure PR -> safe advance B during PR_OPEN -> reprojection -> fresh exact CI -> merge/final receipt.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental/Risk/Quality/TypeScript/Build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle proof and PR-head SUCCESS.
Merge only with expected head, require post-merge main SUCCESS, then replay immutable source SHA 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65.

Acceptance of the rehearsal requires #278 to advance past both parent-main drift points and parent closure to reach final persisted receipt; any different blocker returns to Failure Intake rather than bypass.

requirements.requirement: Parent closure may move from the last child merge to a newer main only through a state-bound fast-forward proof that preserves every CLOSED child material output and then reruns the full parent proof on the accepted current main.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A parent final main different from the last child merge may not be accepted without a valid parent-main-advance proof.
A main advance that changes any CLOSED child material output may not be accepted for parent closure.
A main-advance proof may not be reused against different unit close receipt digests.
Parent Completion Truth/Lifecycle may not close on a main older than the accepted effective final main.

requirements.requirement: A parent closure PR whose main base advances before merge must be safely re-proved and reprojected, not merged stale and not permanently dead-ended.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A closure PR may not merge after its proven base becomes stale.
Closure branch reprojection may not overwrite a remote head without exact force-with-lease protection.
Main advance reconciliation may not create duplicate open closure PRs for one parent transaction.
A reprojected closure head may not reuse CI evidence from its stale predecessor head.

Canonical state 4c576557808f1051aecd3b027e83a09af4cc7ecc has U01/U02/U03 CLOSED, activeUnitId=null, closureEligible=true, lifecyclePhase=TRUTH_GATE. Last child/U03 main is 4cab9376d285a15d4d27d742f7b8b2babb8a5bee; current main 68877e11c05ccddd7c8a7ec584b1732f0e371f73 is a required Control Plane hardening descendant.
